title: Carnaval - No. 12
notable_excerpt: Key: A-flat major. Chord journey: IV - iv6 - bVI6/4 - I - V6 - V - bVII - vi - bVI - II6 - V - bVII - IV5 - bVII, turning back to a tonic Ab close. Texture: two-voice single-line counterpoint with no block chords, fast motion in both hands.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #289796 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel 1879), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~98%, pitch ~95% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op9_carnaval_12.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Carnaval Op. 9.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
